text.en:
A new section is hereby inserted after Section 14 thereof, to be designated as Section 15, which
shall read as follows:
"Sec. 15. Until the organization or appointment of the members of the Metropolitan Manila Commission, the
Governor of Chairman thereof shall exercise the powers and functions of the commission."

The existing Sections 15 and 16 of Presidential Decree No. 824 are hereby renumbered as
Sections 16 and 17, respectively.

This Decree shall take effect as of the date Presidential Decree No. 824 became effective.
Done in the City of Manila, this 27th day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
